about: Commitment to the Q-129 hold-out test set (n8n data sync with checks, Upwork item 4). The cases were written by a separate session that never builds the workflow and never opened tests/make_cases.py, tests/cases/ or any visible case, from STATE.md, BLUEPRINT.md section 5, tests/CASES.md and evals/eval_config.yaml at gate commit 849b93e only, and sealed before the workflow build. This file holds only counts and hashes, no case content.
written_by: separate Claude Code session (Opus 5.5), hold-out writer only; owner Kristian Kobescak
count_per_result_rule: one count per webhook or replay step, by the first listed expected result (2 parallel steps also accept updated and skipped_duplicate); summary steps counted apart
checks_before_sealing: python tests/make_cases.py --check holdout.json --set holdout exit 0 at 849b93e (also on the file extracted from the archive); the writer's own whole-set check exit 0
kept_at: folder q129-holdout in the owner's user profile, outside every repository
how_to_open: At the gated runs only: check that the SHA-256 of holdout.zip equals archive_sha256; if it does not, the hold-out result is void. Extract into a new, empty folder, check that holdout.json has holdout_json_sha256, stop on any case ID or order number shared with tests/cases/visible.json, then follow README.txt inside.
